claims.claim_text: Scores domains for technical disruption on a 1-10 scale

claims.claim_text: Identifies the highest-risk domains from a batch

claims.claim_text: Provides a concrete consequence for each domain analyzed
claims.reason: The consequence description is a subjective agent output not independently verifiable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Accepts one or more domains as input for analysis
